about_the_game:
Supercars, Neon-lit Cities, Cyber-Grids and Endless Highways: Welcome to the Neon Highways Demo, Where the '80s Come Back to Life!

Neon Highways is a Synthwave / Retrowave inspired casual arcade racer that lets you cruise through vibrant, neon-lit streets of the '80s.

The music and visual style of Synthwave, inspired by a retro-futuristic vision of the 1980s, evokes a nostalgic sense of a past that never truly existed, yet feels instantly familiar.

This Demo gives you a first look at this unforgettable road trip through the retro-futuristic world of Neon Highways, with a taste of the game's vibrant synthwave soundtrack and retro aesthetics.

What’s waiting for you in the Neon Highways Demo?

  • 🏁 Regions - Cruise through two neon-lit highways from one of the full game's six unique regions.

  • 🚗 Supercars - Try two of the supercars featured in the full game to experience the thrill of the road.

  • 🎵 Synthwave Soundtrack - Immerse yourself in 3 tracks from the synthwave soundtrack of the full game that set the perfect retro atmosphere.

  • 🎥 Visual Effects - Try one of many retro-inspired visual effects available in the full game, such as CRT scanlines or VHS-style artifacts, bringing the nostalgia of old-school arcades to life.

  • 🎮 Casual Gameplay - Enjoy a relaxing casual arcade racing experience. Switch to Rush Hour mode for heavier traffic and tighter time limits!

Experience the vibrant, retro-futuristic world of Neon Highways and let the neon sun guide you through a world where the '80s never left.

  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB

short_description: Try out the Demo of Neon Highways, a retro-futuristic arcade racer. This preview lets you cruise through 2 vibrant cityscape levels from the full game, all set to an iconic synthwave soundtrack.
